title: kit.search-qa.v1
description: search-qa.json of a site: the typed queries `kit site search-qa` adds to the ones it derives from the site's own search index (docs/SITE.md). Every case names what must hold; a case with none of expect, typo, highlight, none, hint or sameAs only has to run without a console error.

pages.description: Pages on which Ctrl+K must open exactly one dialog (default: the home page). List every page that owns the key (a terminal's command palette).

latencyMs.description: Budget for the median time from a key press to the next frame with the results (default 130).

derive.description: false: only the cases listed here (default: also the ones derived from the index).

q.description: The query, typed key by key.

within.description: The page must be among the first N results (default 3).

typo.description: The page must say it searched for a corrected word.

highlight.description: A word that must be marked in the results.

none.description: No result: the empty state shows.

hint.description: Too short to search: the hint shows.

sameAs.description: Another query that must rank the same first three pages (folding: letter variants, ZWNJ, digits, case).
